crossRefs.note: The woman said to him, “Sir, I perceive that you are a prophet.
When therefore the people saw the sign which Jesus did, they said, “This is truly the prophet who comes into the world.”
He said to them, “What things?” They said to him, “The things concerning Jesus, the Nazarene, who was a prophet mighty…
“Men of Israel, hear these words! Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved by God to you by mighty works and wonders and signs…
For Moses indeed said to the fathers, ‘The Lord God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me.…
even Jesus of Nazareth, how God anointed him with the Holy Spirit and with power, who went about doing good and healing…

translations.web: Therefore they asked the blind man again, “What do you say about him, because he opened your eyes?” He said, “He is a prophet.”
translations.bsb: So once again they asked the man who had been blind, “What do you say about Him, since it was your eyes He opened?” “He is a prophet,” the man replied.
translations.kjv: They say unto the blind man again, What sayest thou of him, that he hath opened thine eyes? He said, He is a prophet.
translations.asv: They say therefore unto the blind man again, What sayest thou of him, in that he opened thine eyes? And he said, He is a prophet.
